review: security Go bug fixed in Rust
reason: Frozen Go reads user_risk fail-open: a failed risk read drops the risk claim and its requires_mfa step-up. Rust refuses before any token is signed or stored, including when the feature.user_risk lookup itself fails: password login answers 500 'token issue failed'; refresh reads the risk only after the reducer has decided to mint (a revoked, expired or replayed token keeps its 401 and reuse revocation) and answers 503 with Retry-After: 5, rotating and signing nothing. A stored signals value that is not an array of strings refuses the same way (Go issues the claim with null signals).
